title: The marble book wave
alt: The pages of an open marble book rise into a curling stone wave traced with gold.
description: A sculptural transformation preserves the book structure while extending its pages into a carved wave.
prompt: An extraordinary monumental sculpture carved from pale marble: one open book whose pages rise into a flowing wave of finely separated stone sheets. The book has a continuous spine, clearly layered pages and a solid lower cover resting on a dark rectangular plinth. Delicate gold inlay traces subtle contour lines along the wave without forming letters. Full sculpture visible in a quiet modern gallery, tactile chisel marks and natural marble veins, exquisite raking light, no people or writing.
